en.headline: Observatory cancels amber rainstorm warning at 10:30pm
en.dek: The amber signal lasted a little over two hours. A thunderstorm warning had been extended to 11:30pm, with gusts of 70 km/h still possible.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the amber rainstorm warning at 10:30pm on Sunday, RTHK reported. The signal had been issued at 8:20pm as showers and squally thunderstorms tied to a cold front moved across the Pearl River estuary.

An Observatory weather report issued at 10:31pm said the thunderstorm warning remained in force until 11:30pm, and that a few squally thunderstorms were still expected over Hong Kong. The same bulletin warned that gusts of 70 kilometres per hour or more could affect the city, and asked people to take shelter. It also said that, although the rainstorm warning had been cancelled, people should stay alert to the risk of flooding along watercourses.

At 10pm the Observatory recorded 26 degrees Celsius and relative humidity of 86 per cent. Between 8:45pm and 9:45pm, lightning was detected across the territory. Provisional rainfall in that hour ranged from 1 to 42 millimetres in Yuen Long, 1 to 33 millimetres in Tsuen Wan, and up to 31 millimetres in the Islands district, with Wong Tai Sin recording 8 to 15 millimetres.

The Observatory has said showers should ease on Monday, with a slightly cooler morning minimum of about 25 degrees and a daytime high of about 31 degrees. It expects the urban minimum to fall to about 23 degrees on Tuesday and Wednesday, and drier weather later in the week.

zh.headline: 天文台晚上10時30分取消黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 黃雨警告生效約兩小時後取消。雷暴警告曾延長至晚上11時30分，天文台仍提醒陣風可達每小時70公里。
body: 香港電台報道，天文台在星期日晚上10時30分取消黃色暴雨警告信號。該信號於晚上8時20分發出，當時與冷鋒相關的驟雨及狂風雷暴正影響珠江口一帶。
天文台晚上10時31分的天氣報告表示，雷暴警告仍然生效，有效時間至晚上11時30分，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。同一份報告指，高達每小時70公里或以上的強陣風可能吹襲香港，呼籲市民盡快到安全地方躲避。報告又指，雖然暴雨警告已經取消，市民仍須警覺河道泛濫可能帶來的危險。
晚上10時，天文台錄得氣溫26度，相對濕度百分之86。晚上8時45分至9時45分，本港各區均有閃電記錄。該小時暫測雨量方面，元朗錄得1至42毫米，荃灣1至33毫米，離島區最多31毫米，黃大仙則有8至15毫米。
天文台早前表示，星期一驟雨會減少，明早稍涼，最低氣溫約25度，日間最高約31度。周二及周三市區最低氣溫料降至約23度，周中後期天氣轉乾。
